name: Vecturia
tagline: Careful shipping for things that can't be reordered.
positioning: Vecturia handles pickup, packing guidance, and tracked delivery for one-of-a-kind and handmade goods — built for makers, collectors, and everyday senders.

hero.sub: Vecturia moves the pottery, the framed print, the vintage guitar — the parcels no algorithm should touch. Get a packing plan, a real courier, and tracking that actually reassures you.

features.title: Packing plans, not guesswork
features.description: Tell us what you're sending — a glazed vase, a signed canvas — and get a step-by-step wrap guide with the exact materials, before anything ships.

features.title: Handled by named couriers
features.description: Every leg is carried by a vetted courier you can see, not a mystery van. Fragile items travel upright, cushioned, and never re-stacked.

features.title: Tracking that tells a story
features.description: Real photos at pickup and drop-off, timestamps that make sense, and a heads-up before your parcel changes hands. No more refreshing a blank map.

features.title: Repair-grade insurance
features.description: Coverage that pays a restorer, not a form letter. We connect you with conservators for the rare cases where care isn't enough.

features.title: One label, whole journey
features.description: Print a single label at home and we manage every relay — pickup, sorting, and the final knock on the door.

features.title: Built for one-offs
features.description: No minimums, no freight accounts. Send a single lamp on Tuesday and a wedding cake stand on Friday, same simple flow.

testimonials.quote: I sell wheel-thrown mugs to collectors across three states. Vecturia's packing plan cut my breakages from a handful a month to zero. The pickup photos alone earned me repeat buyers.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: I shipped my late father's violin to a restorer and was terrified the whole way. Their courier sent a photo of it strapped upright in a padded case. I actually teared up a little.
testimonials.name: Marcus Reyes

testimonials.quote: We handle estate art moves for private clients. Vecturia is the first service that treats a single framed piece with the same rigor as a gallery crate. It's become our default.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For sellers who ship fragile goods weekly.
For studios and advisors moving high-value pieces.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vecturia carries the irreplaceable — from a single handmade bowl to an heirloom worth its own history. Careful by default.
